# Hardware references

The tools cite hardware specifications through their canonical sources.
Reference text is not bundled.

| Reference | Source | Use |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Nocash PlayStation specifications | [Martin Korth's document](https://problemkaputt.de/psx-spx.htm) | Hardware, SPU, CD-ROM and XA facts. |
| psx-spx community edition | [psx-spx](https://psx-spx.consoledev.net/) | Maintained hardware reference with section links. |

See the [SPU model evidence](https://github.com/raulcorreia7/bof3-player/blob/main/docs/spu-model.md#evidence) and
[wiki sources](https://raulcorreia7.github.io/bof3-wiki/appendix/sources.html) for the references behind each feature.
